policy.title: Rules of Use
policy.subtitle: Please read this once. It is short.
policy.intro: This system holds the records of {shopName}. Everyone who logs in agrees to these rules.
policy.rule1Body: Never tell anyone your password and never write it where others can see it. If you think somebody learned it, tell the admin right away so it can be changed.
policy.rule2Body: If you used a shared phone or computer, tap Log out before you walk away. The system also logs you out by itself after 30 minutes of no use.
policy.rule3Body: Look only at the customers and jobs you need for your work. Do not share customer names, phone numbers or job details with anyone outside the shop.
policy.rule4Body: The system keeps a log of every log-in and every job, customer or account that is added, changed or deleted. The owner can read this log at any time.
policy.rule5Body: If you see a job you did not make, a log-in you did not do, or anything that looks wrong, tell the admin at once.
policy.acknowledge: I have read and understood these rules
policy.acknowledged: Thank you. You may now use the system.
